title: Switzerland to hold five days of mourning after 40 killed in resort fire
summary: Blaze that swept through crowded New Year’s Eve bar in Crans-Montana also injured 115 people Swiss resort fire: latest updates Le Constellation bar fire in Switzerland: what we know so far Switzerland will hold five days of mourning after an “unprecedented” fire tore through a crowded bar, killing about 40 people and injuring 115 who were celebrating at a New Year’s Eve party in the Alpine ski resort of Crans-Montana. The country’s president, Guy Parmelin, described the blaze as one of the most traumatic events in Switzerland’s history. “It was a drama of an unknown scale,” he said, paying tribute to the many “young lives that were lost and interrupted”.
